purpose: A small, explicitly authorised first-party machine-interface cohort for local candidate generation. This is not a source registry and does not activate sources outside these routes.
selection_criteria: first-party machine interface explicitly recorded in the Source Registry
automated monitoring use is cleared or explicitly bounded
ingestion is limited to factual metadata or a bounded official data response
bounded low-rate route with a documented source role
substantive publication/decision evidence preferred over calendar-only coverage

routes.role: substantive monetary-policy publication metadata; not FOMC schedule authority
official fiscal/sovereign publication metadata; not auction schedule authority
official monetary-policy publication metadata; not forward schedule authority
official monetary-policy publication metadata; internal candidate use only
official macroeconomic release metadata; no article-body republication
official institutional meeting/publication metadata; minimal factual metadata
official monetary-policy publication metadata; internal candidate use only
bounded first-party policy publication metadata and minimal semantic state

excluded_families.calendar_only: Excluded from v1 unless a route exposes substantive publication metadata; calendar monitoring remains the Monitor layer.
excluded_families.rights_or_endpoint_hold: Excluded even where the institution is authoritative. ACTIVE in the registry is not retrieval permission.
excluded_families.licensed_or_paid: No paid, licensed, commercial market, AIS, newswire or terminal route is activated.
excluded_families.security_and_hazard: No additional security or hazard route is activated in v1 because the currently governed candidates are manual, schedule-only or held; gaps are documented separately.
excluded_families.opec: OPEC remains quarantined and is not used as a base, cohort route or promotion source.
